s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive neurological decline with motor and speech impairment
salient_findings: Episodes of spasms and tremors in the right hand and forearm
Extensive nonenhancing lesions in the bilateral cerebral hemispheres on MRI
key_facts: Woman in her mid-60s
Initial presentation with episodes of spasms and tremors in the right hand and forearm
Underwent carpal tunnel release surgery
Tremors recurred 7 months later
Developed progressive right-sided weakness over 3 months
Dysarthria and slurred speech developed over 3 months
Gait instability developed over 3 months
Brain MRI showed hyperintensities throughout the bilateral cerebral hemispheric white matter, corpus callosum, basal ganglia, thalami, midbrain, upper pons, and middle cerebellar peduncles
T1-weighted fluid-attenuated inversion recovery MRI with contrast showed absence of contrast enhancement
Brain biopsy showed CD19+ CD20+ BCL6+ MUM-1+ EBV/EBER− cells
Cerebrospinal fluid contained lymphoma cells
Bone marrow was negative for lymphoma cells

raw.syndrome_frame: Progressive neurological decline with motor and speech impairment
salient_findings: Episodes of spasms and tremors in the right hand and forearm
Extensive nonenhancing lesions in the bilateral cerebral hemispheres on MRI
key_facts: Woman in her mid-60s
Initial presentation with episodes of spasms and tremors in the right hand and forearm
Underwent carpal tunnel release surgery
Tremors recurred 7 months later
Developed progressive right-sided weakness over 3 months
Dysarthria and slurred speech developed over 3 months
Gait instability developed over 3 months
Brain MRI showed hyperintensities throughout the bilateral cerebral hemispheric white matter, corpus callosum, basal ganglia, thalami, midbrain, upper pons, and middle cerebellar peduncles
T1-weighted fluid-attenuated inversion recovery MRI with contrast showed absence of contrast enhancement
Brain biopsy showed CD19+ CD20+ BCL6+ MUM-1+ EBV/EBER− cells
Cerebrospinal fluid contained lymphoma cells
Bone marrow was negative for lymphoma cells

raw.rationale: The presence of lymphoma cells in the cerebrospinal fluid and the brain biopsy showing CD19+ CD20+ BCL6+ MUM-1+ EBV/EBER− cells are highly indicative of lymphoma, specifically Primary Central Nervous System Lymphoma, given the involvement of the central nervous system and the absence of systemic lymphoma as indicated by a negative bone marrow test.

rejected.label: Multiple Sclerosis
rejected.why: While Multiple Sclerosis can present with similar MRI findings, the presence of lymphoma cells in the cerebrospinal fluid and the specific immunophenotype of the cells in the brain biopsy are not characteristic of MS.

rejected.label: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy
rejected.why: This condition typically occurs in immunocompromised patients and is caused by the JC virus, which is not mentioned in the case, and the biopsy findings do not support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Mitochondrial Encephalomyopathy
rejected.why: The clinical presentation and imaging findings do not align with Mitochondrial Encephalomyopathy, and the biopsy results indicate a lymphomatous process rather than a mitochondrial disorder.

rejected.label: Glioblastoma Multiforme
rejected.why: While Glioblastoma Multiforme is a primary brain tumor, the biopsy findings of lymphoma cells and the presence of these cells in the cerebrospinal fluid do not support this diagnosis.
